terra.problem: The passage does not say the law is written on the stones for everybody to see.
The passage prohibits iron tools and calls for uncut stones. It does not prohibit all hammers.
The passage does not mention a valley or call Gerizim the blessing side of one.
The Levites are instructed to proclaim a general curse. The text does not say they call it out whenever someone moves a stone.
Nobody gets cursed for being handy is a broad claim the passage does not make.
The text does not say the person sees the blind man heading the wrong way and does nothing.
The curse names three groups, not three individual people.
